assets.prompt: Seamless square PBR base-color texture for a robotics simulation warehouse floor. Straight overhead orthographic material scan, entire frame is a continuous pale warm-gray matte epoxy floor with extremely fine aggregate and tiny gentle wear. Clean maintained industrial facility. Very low contrast so robot paths and people stay legible. Physically flat color under uniform diffuse lighting; no cast shadows, no perspective, no objects, no lettering, no lines, no tiles or framing, no vignette. Tile seamlessly in both directions. 1024 by 1024.

Seamless square PBR base-color texture for clean factory wall panels in a robotics simulation. Entire image a flat front-facing off-white warm light-gray powder-coated metal wall panel surface with one very fine vertical recessed panel seam at the center and subtle smooth painted microtexture. Orthographic, uniform lighting with no directional shadows, no perspective, no objects, no screws, no lettering, no borders. Left and right edges continuous; designed for repeating horizontally and vertically. Restrained, precise industrial finish. 1024 by 1024.

Seamless square PBR base-color texture of satin stainless steel for the doors and interior walls of a working industrial elevator in a robotics simulation. Full-frame flat orthographic material swatch of pale silver steel, fine continuous vertical brushing, low-contrast grain, soft neutral silver color. Uniform diffuse lighting, no reflections of objects, no specular spotlight, no dark gradient, no border, no bolts, no text, no perspective. Seamless repeating in both axes. 1024 by 1024.

Seamless square PBR base-color texture for warehouse anti-slip stair treads. Full-frame straight overhead material swatch of dark graphite gray metal with small repeating low-relief diamond tread pattern. Low contrast, clean lightly worn industrial metal, crisp enough to read in a 3D map. Neutral uniform diffuse light, no dramatic shadows, no perspective, no scene, no objects, no text, no border. Tile seamlessly both directions. 1024 by 1024.

Square flat UV albedo texture for the torso of an existing cylindrical 3D warehouse pedestrian jacket. The entire image is the unwrapped jacket fabric, not a picture of a person or a jacket silhouette. Muted teal blue tightly woven workwear fabric fills all pixels, with two clean pale silver reflective horizontal bands extending edge to edge across the lower-middle region. Subtle fabric weave, soft stitched edges on reflective bands, no pockets, no zipper, no collar, no body parts, no text, no logo, no border, no black background, no perspective and no shadows. Left and right edges must join continuously when wrapped around a torso. Uniform diffuse flat color. 1024 by 1024.
